messages.content: I am interested in getting a credit card. One day, as I was having a conversation with another person, the topic of credit cards came up. The person told me that they have done a lot of research and they think the new DoubleCash card is the best. Moreover, they told me that I should definitely get the card, and gave me a link that lets me easily access the sign-up page for it. I learned that DoubleCash offers referral bonuses of varying amounts. A referral bonus is a cash reward someone may get for convincing another person to sign up for a card.  Say that the person I am talking with is my close friend and that DoubleCash offers a referral bonus of $10, meaning that if I sign up for the card, my close friend earns $10. On a scale from 0 to 100, how much do you think my close friend would value receiving the $10 referral bonus from my signup, with 0 meaning extremely valuable and 100 meaning not valuable at all? Please only respond with an integer score, do not include anything else.
